reviews.text:
I started going to this salon after a recommendation from one of my Instagram followers, and I've been a repeat customer for almost five years now.

The owner is a highly skilled professional who also works as a seminar instructor.

I was surprised to later learn that the owner was the one who created a cute haircut I saw in a grooming magazine.

Their unique cuts are adorable, and people always compliment my dog's cuteness when we go for walks.

The photos of the dogs after grooming, which change monthly, are also a highlight, as they are created by a popular groomer!

The owner's love for dogs is so strong that their attitude might sometimes be misunderstood.

Honestly, there have been a few times when I thought, "Couldn't they be a little gentler?" (laughs), but I think that's because they love my dog ​​like family! So I'll continue to be a repeat customer.

If you don't think it's a good fit, you simply don't have to go; overall, it's a very good salon.

Above all, seeing the blissful look on my dog's face when I drop them off tells me they're a great groomer! ♡

I've been getting my dog ​​shampooed every month since he was a puppy. 🫧
He's so cute from the outside, I've always wanted to ask him to do it for me when I get a new dog. 😊

This is my first dog, so they're always happy to help me with any questions I might have, and they're so kind and helpful. ✨✨

The photos after the shampoo are always so cute. 🤍
The booth is so stylish, I always look forward to seeing what the atmosphere will be like next time. ☺️
I'm also happy to be able to look back on his growth in the photo book. ☺️

I love the owner and the staff, so
He gets so excited when I tell him I'm coming for a shampoo! 🐶🤍
Thank you for always keeping him so fluffy and smooth. ✨I look forward to your continued support. ✨

We've been bringing our dog to Rosange about once a month since she was a puppy.

My dog ​​loves Rosange too; she rushes to the groomer as soon as we arrive! ✨
I'm sure it's because all the staff are so kind to her. Thank you so much!

When she stays overnight, they send us photos so we can check on her and feel at ease leaving her in their care.

And the grooming is simply amazing!

Even when we're out for a walk, passersby often compliment her, saying "So cute! So cute!" 💓

It's a bit of a distance from our home, but I can't imagine going anywhere else, so we'll keep coming back! ♡

My dog
loves the staff and always looks happy when he comes for a grooming session.
They're very good at cutting his hair, and the end result is always perfectly round and fluffy!
The store is also very clean and designed to be comfortable for dogs, so he always seems to be able to relax even after the grooming session, so I can always leave him in their care with peace of mind.

I've been using this salon since my beloved dogs, Sabu and Shiro, were puppies! I get my grooming done every two months, and they're always so helpful and willing to help me with any questions I have. ✨
Their photos have intricate backgrounds, and I make a calendar every year to use at home. ❤️
They just renovated, and the interior is clean and fun for my dogs, so I'm thinking of using their hotel there soon. 😊

I have my two dogs groomed once a month. Their technique is excellent, as they keep their hair neat and unkempt between grooming sessions. And best of all, the staff are so kind to dogs! It's clear that all the dogs love this salon and are happy to come. They carefully observe every detail during grooming, and sometimes even take them to the vet. They're also knowledgeable about food and dog supplies, and if you search for authorized retailers of quality products, you'll often find their name listed. This is a trustworthy salon that I highly recommend.
They also offer a photo service as a separate course from the grooming, and you'll receive the fluffiest, cutest photo of your dog after the grooming session. The photos will grow in your planner, so if you keep coming, you'll have several books full of wonderful memories, which is great. Thank you as always!

I always leave my two beloved dogs here.
I've been going there for years, and they're used to the owner and the staff, so I feel comfortable leaving them there.
The owner hasn't been coming to the salon as often recently, but when he's there, he always has a lovely smile on his face.
I'm always pleased with how they take care of my elderly dog's skin condition, physical condition, and stamina! They also take adorable photos every time, which I look forward to.
I think the cutting technique varies slightly from person to person, but I think that's the same at any salon.
I think this is a great salon, as they take photos of both dogs together and adjust the pick-up time on bad weather days.
I look forward to continuing to work with them!

Thank you so much for always giving my dog ​​such a cute haircut, even though her fur isn't very long and styling is usually difficult. I also look forward to seeing the photos taken in the photo booth, which changes every month! The shop is always clean, and all the staff are dog lovers, so I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​there. We've moved and it's a bit further now, but I want to keep coming back for a long time to come.

This is my third grooming salon, Losange, and I've finally found one that gives me the cut I've always wanted, and I've been going there for over four years now. 
They give me advice on various cuts and let me know about health conditions that owners might not be aware of, so I trust them enough to leave every visit to them. Most of all, the staff are so affectionate towards dogs, so my dog ​​enjoys going there without any stress, and I feel at ease knowing they enjoy it. Their prices are a little on the higher side, so they spend more on grooming than us, but I can't imagine going anywhere else, so I'd like to continue going there. I also like the cute photos they send me every time, so I have a record of them. I look forward to continuing to work with them in the future.
